[404] === api auth endpoints ===
/api/auth/signup         "Bad request." [400]
/api/auth/sign-up        "Bad request." [400]
/api/v1/auth/signup      {"error":"Not found"} [404]

observation.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://venice.ai/signup" -o /tmp/vs.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(turnstile|recaptcha|hcaptcha|sitekey|0x4AAAAA|6L[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,})" /tmp/vs.html | sort -u | head -8; echo "=== api auth endpoints ==="; for p in "/api/auth/signup" "/api/auth/sign-up" "/api/v1/auth/signup"; do printf "%-24s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST "https://api.venice.ai$p" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' -w " [%{http_code}]" | head -c 100; echo; done
